Please go today, now if you can, to an urgent care that has X-ray and ECG, or to the emergency department.

- coughing up blood

baseline.rationale: 28M with left-sided pleuritic chest pain starting a day after heavy chest training. He reports no dyspnea, no leg swelling and no smoking, so a musculoskeletal strain is most likely and PE risk is low. Pleuritic pain after heavy lifting in a young man still raises spontaneous pneumothorax, and pericarditis is also possible. Pain reproducible with palpation or arm movement supports chest wall strain. Sudden-onset or non-reproducible pain, any breathlessness, or positional features (worse lying flat, better leaning forward) would warrant a same-day chest X-ray and ECG. Ibuprofen is reasonable if he has no contraindications. Floor is async physician follow-up pending his answers.
